purpose: Paired deterministic specification sensitivity, followed by separately labelled conditional time-series bootstrap; no primary strategy replacement
selection_context: Designed after reading historical results, endpoint dependence and fee feedback. Frozen before this new matrix/bootstrap; not a pristine preregistration or holdout.

fixed.costs: unchanged baseline Swissquote current-cost scenario; embedded ETF costs not deducted twice
fixed.financing_reference: unchanged observed indicative/SOFR reference series with ACT/360 accrual
fixed.calendar: the original five-series common NAV calendar; no interpolation or ETF-only calendar substitution

design: one_at_a_time; no full factorial grid; report every requested case including unavailable cases

cases.unavailable_reason: Frozen common NAV and financing snapshots begin3October2014; no earlier levels will be invented or acquired for this block.

fund_fee.regular_rule: annual fee/12 charged on prior event closing net equity at the first common NAV on or after each anniversary-month date, anchored on the case start
fund_fee.funding: post to debt in the borrowed no-client fund; preserve original mark/funding/prior-trade/fee/new-signal order
fund_fee.terminal_stub_extension: if cutoff is not a regular fee event, charge once on the cutoff NAV: annual fee * calendar days since last actual fee event /365.2425 * prior-event closing net equity; post to debt; no double charge on regular-event dates
fund_fee.scope: This is a specified extension for irregular robustness endpoints, not a change to the old120-month inflow account or zero-added-fee primary backtest.

timing_secondary.status: separate follow-up timing experiment, excluded from first matrix
timing_secondary.gate: default next-NAV mode must remain exactly equivalent and second-NAV mode needs explicit paired regression checks

per_pair: factor/core CAGR and signed gap in percentage points
reporting.summaries: baseline, median, minimum, maximum and sign by endpoint and perturbation family; display sample counts; no probability/significance inferred from parameter span
reporting.core_sleeve_band: not applicable; unchanged Core cases may be reused and must not be counted as independent corroboration
reporting.tracking_error: std of aligned investor net-return differences, ddof1, times sqrt252
reporting.information_ratio: mean aligned arithmetic active return times252 divided by tracking error; unavailable if tracking error is zero

bootstrap.scope: Only the full-period baseline factor1.25/Core1.25 realised net investment-return pair; no rule rerun, specification uncertainty, causal attribution or future performance guarantee
bootstrap.method: paired stationary circular-block resampling; jointly use the same indices for both arrays; restart probability1/expected_block_length, otherwise increment and wrap
bootstrap.opening_cost: hold each original post-entry equity/committed-capital factor fixed once per replicate; resample adjacent post-entry equity returns without resampling the opening charge
bootstrap.statistic: difference of each compounded calendar-year CAGR using the original elapsed-year divisor; use paired log-return sums plus fixed entry-cost factor
bootstrap.confidence_interval: two-sided95percent percentile interval, report both predefined block lengths; no selection by outcome; do not call an untested CAGR gap nonsignificant
bootstrap.limits: conditional on the realised strategy-return streams and resampling assumptions; threshold rules and financing/holdings are not recomputed under new paths

validation.baseline: zero-fee coupled factor/Core must match original histories and metrics; original14-job references and current report figures stay protected
validation.bootstrap_original_order: the unresampled post-entry return pair plus one opening-cost factor must recover both original CAGRs
validation.fail_closed: mark unavailable/incomplete cases and explain; do not weaken tolerances, change inputs, tune parameters or replace expected results to obtain a desired answer

publication: implement using the authoritative GitHub checkout; copy this frozen protocol unchanged into public config/docs with freeze checks before result interpretation; originals remain private; update reports/package only after reviewed checks
